name: Crownsfall — Central Plaza
scale_note: Z1 painting (Higgsfield 6.5 cr, job 5fdae107). Lamp post ~336 px = ~2.1 hero heights at ppm 149 (hero 160 px in painting px); planter ~72 px = knee height. Shown at 110/160 so the hero is ~110 px at 1080p.

exits.name: Highward Steps
exits.threshold: Grand stairs up to the citadel quarter (top-left of the plaza)

exits.name: Kingsroad Fields
exits.threshold: South steps down to the lower city and the Kingsroad Gate (bottom of the plaza)

waypoints.name: Crownsfall Plaza
waypoints.centre_note: Compass rose ring centre measures (1902,860); owner moved the waypoint up/right to sit visually centred (11-22).

camera_note: Owner-approved 31-degree camera (2026-11-22): matches the paintings' ground angle (circles 0.51 tall/wide). ppm rescaled from 149.0 at 52 deg so the painting keeps its on-screen size; hero stays 110 px.
